name: week
title: This week in rates
subtitle: Council Rates for Claude Code: arrears, penalties, relief and the roll, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Arrears, oldest first
sections.note: The next step comes from the council's ladder in settings and the s 62 mortgagee timing.
sections.sql: select assessment_no, address, coalesce(ratepayer_names, '(no ratepayer)') as ratepayer, overdue_cents::bigint as overdue_cents, days_overdue, next_step from v_arrears order by days_overdue desc, overdue_cents desc

sections.title: Instalments
sections.sql: select y.label as year, i.no, i.due_on, i.penalty_on, i.issued_on as invoiced_on, i.penalties_applied_on, (select coalesce(sum(u.unpaid_cents), 0)::bigint from unpaid_on_instalment(i.id, current_date) u) as unpaid_cents from instalments i join rating_years y on y.id = i.rating_year_id where y.starts_on <= current_date and y.ends_on >= current_date order by i.no

sections.title: Relief, rebates and objections waiting
sections.sql: select 'Remission or postponement' as what, u.assessment_no, a.policy_code as detail, a.received_on from relief_applications a join rating_units u on u.id = a.rating_unit_id where a.status = 'received' union all select 'Rebate to decide', u.assessment_no, r.applicant, r.received_on from rebate_applications r join rating_units u on u.id = r.rating_unit_id where r.status = 'received' union all select 'Rebate to claim from DIA', u.assessment_no, r.applicant, r.decided_on from rebate_applications r join rating_units u on u.id = r.rating_unit_id where r.status = 'approved' union all select 'Objection (s 29)', u.assessment_no, o.objector, o.received_on from objections o join rating_units u on u.id = o.rating_unit_id where o.status = 'open' order by 4

sections.title: Gaps in the rating information database
sections.sql: select u.assessment_no, u.address, case when n.ratepayer_count = 0 then 'No ratepayer on file' when u.valuation_date < current_date - interval '3 years' then 'Value over 3 years old' else 'No rates assessment this year' end as gap from rating_units u join v_ratepayer_names n on n.rating_unit_id = u.id where u.status = 'active' and (n.ratepayer_count = 0 or u.valuation_date < current_date - interval '3 years' or not exists (select 1 from assessments a join rating_years y on y.id = a.rating_year_id where a.rating_unit_id = u.id and y.starts_on <= current_date and y.ends_on >= current_date)) order by u.assessment_no

name: revenue
title: Rates revenue
subtitle: What this year's strike raises, by rate and by category

sections.title: By rate
sections.sql: select rt.code, rt.name, rt.kind, rt.basis, count(*)::int as units, sum(l.amount_cents)::bigint as revenue_cents from assessment_lines l join assessments a on a.id = l.assessment_id join rate_types rt on rt.id = l.rate_type_id join rating_years y on y.id = a.rating_year_id where y.starts_on <= current_date and y.ends_on >= current_date group by rt.id order by 6 desc

sections.title: By category
sections.sql: select a.category_code as category, count(*)::int as units, sum(a.capital_value_cents)::bigint as capital_value_cents, sum(a.total_cents)::bigint as rates_cents, (sum(a.total_cents) / nullif(count(*), 0))::bigint as average_cents from assessments a join rating_years y on y.id = a.rating_year_id where y.starts_on <= current_date and y.ends_on >= current_date group by 1 order by 4 desc
